Hello! I came across your work and I really liked it! So I would like to request you to draw my character! ^^ My reference sheets are below. Raven is a black-haired girl who is very playful and often/loves to tease Cain. She's a bit bratty and likes to pull tricks on him, and a bit obsessed too. The other character is Cain. He is serious but gets shy easily. He likes to sleep a lot . They are a couple! You can decide the pose and expression based on the information and references! My only request is to give a romantic/dark atmosphere if possible! Also, if you feel like the price is not fair please feel free to request a resend or if you don't feel comfortable please cancel. Thank you for considering my request ^^
